Definition: from G2505 and G4007; exactly as:--(even, as well) as.
BiblicalUsage: As we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office, so the body is one and hath many members, and all the members of that one body are one.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the body works because the members are different, and no member is the whole body alone.
